newsitem.title: USA: HFS Inc. reports record third-quarter profit.
newsitem.headline: HFS Inc. reports record third-quarter profit.

text.p: HFS Inc., the nation's largest franchisor of hotels and residential real estate offices, said Wednesday that its profits jumped 125 percent in the third quarter.

HFS, which this month acquired Avis Inc., the world's second-largest rental car system, said net income for the three months ended Sept. 30 soared to $61.1 million, or 44 cents a share, from $27.1 million, or 24 cents a share.
The company said the results marked its 16th consecutive record-breaking quarter since it became a public company in 1992.
HFS said its revenues increased 90 percent to $245.8 million from $129.2 million in the quarter as it posted record franchise sales and openings in both its lodging and real estate businesses.
It also said unit growth in its three real estate franchise systems and higher sales at offices opened more than a year also boosted earnings.
For the first nine months net income increased 107 percent to $122.6 million, or 96 cents a share, from $59.4 million, or 56 cents a share.
Revenues for the year to date increased 84 percent to $550.0 million from $299.7 million.
HFS's stock slipped 62.5 cents to $74.125 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
